objective: Fix actual Godot packed world smoke teardown resource leak: 2 resources still in use when immediate SceneTree.quit triggers engine shutdown, preserving strict ERROR detection.
productionBaselineEvidence: Run 45142857395 exported real 34,970,724-byte GDPC pack with Arena ready/smoke passing and no missing WebP/WAV log errors; packed world smoke emitted 'ERROR: 2 resources still in use at exit'. Main source SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f remains only source snapshot; no deployed/runtime verification.
chosenApproach: Release test-owned AudioStreamPlayer, WorldPreview node and loaded GDScript reference, then defer SceneTree.quit until GDScript stack returns; still reject every engine ERROR and inspect all packed resources. Re-run only bounded, isolated Godot CI diagnostic.
selectionRationale: Immediate quit while test-owned world/audio/script references remain is an artificial smoke shutdown error, not reason to suppress engine errors. Explicit teardown and deferred quit ensures actual lifecycle correctness.
